issue.title: docs/stats.md Day strip height budget (56/80 px) is stale; the preview harness enforces 84/136 px

task_type_fields.impact: Docs contract misstates the strip's height budget by 28-56 px; agents changing the strip may wrongly treat the shipped 81/132 px strip as over budget or tune against the wrong numbers. Low severity, docs only.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. `sed -n 978,984p docs/stats.md` (### Day strip, Layout paragraph) reads: "Height budget at a 16 px base: at most 56 px when the facts fit on one line (540 and 700 px), at most 80 px when they wrap once (410 px)." `git log -S "at most 56 px" -- docs/stats.md` shows it came from 24fcc300 (2026-10-25), written for the earlier inline LABEL-value layout.
2. In bob-plugins, `scripts/preview-day-strip.cjs:225` enforces `item.factRows <= 1 ? 84 : 136` and its matrix-report sentence says "≤84 px when the facts fit on one row, ≤136 px when they fold to two rows". These budgets landed with the stacked stat-row redesign (bob-plugins 04c61c7, 2026-10-25), whose plan updated the harness but not the docs numbers.
3. Rendering the production `main.js` + `styles.css` (bob-plugins 43a04d6) in headless Chrome at a 16 px base measures today's strip at 81.1 px on one row (540/700 px) and 131.6 px folded (410 px) — over the documented 56/80 px, within the enforced 84/136 px.

Fix: change the docs/stats.md sentence to 84 px / 136 px (and "fold to two rows"), then `just docs-check`. If the typical-day rail from research:202610/day_strip_typical_day_comparison__cld.md is adopted, its docs phase raises these to 94/156 px instead.

issue.creation_reason: Found while measuring Day strip geometry for the 7-day comparison research: the documented budget predates the stat-row redesign and contradicts the enforced harness numbers, so docs readers and future agents get the wrong contract.

payload.description: Same stat-row redesign era; that fix also edits the Day strip preview harness checks
